# Real SOLIDWORKS output (not synthetic)

plate_4holes.report.json and plate_4holes.step were written 2026-10-17 by
`astracad_cad spec _win/sw4/plate_4holes.json --authorize KM` on SOLIDWORKS 2026 SP04.1
(100 x 40 x 10 mm plate, Ø6 hole x linear pattern 4 @ 20 mm). Kernel volume 38869.026645 mm^3
equals the analytic expectation. Used by the costing tests as genuine CAD evidence.
